summary: Comprehensive testing of NexUacademy Admin Panel, Role-based Authentication, and Page Titles. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed - Admin login/logout, teacher creation, teacher/student login with role-based redirect, signup page student-only restriction, and page titles all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test teachers created during testing with TEST_ prefix for cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel at /admin uses separate admin auth (admin_session_token cookie). Admin can create teacher accounts. Teachers login at /login and redirect to /teacher. Students login at /login and redirect to /dashboard. Signup at /signup is student-only (no role selector, batch selection required). All page titles include 'NexUacademy'. Google OAuth via AuthCallback.js also has role-based redirect.
